property_summary: After calling SetLogFile(addr) from any caller, the reference contract always leaves intitalized == false until SetLogFile returns (so if the callee reenters and re-calls SetLogFile the reentry is blocked by the initial check), whereas the mutant sets intitalized true before assigning LogFile which can allow different revert/reentry effects and thus different external-visible outcomes; therefore the reference never observes SetLogFile reentrantly succeeding while the mutant can change that behavior for some callee that reenters.
change_summary: Reverse the order: set intitalized before assigning LogFile, causing different revert behavior if SetLogFile reentered (and making intitalized true earlier).
